$comment: The liberrpa.Modules enum is a static snapshot of the built-in import order used by LiberRPA 0.3.0.
title: LiberRPA Favorite Snippet Configuration
description: User-maintained Favorite Snippets loaded by LiberRPA Snippets Tree.

schemaVersion.markdownDescription: Favorite Snippet configuration schema version. The current and only supported value is `1`.

snippets.markdownDescription: Favorite Snippets keyed by their unique titles. Each title is used as the Tree label when `label` is omitted.

defaultSnippets.label: Add a Favorite Snippet
defaultSnippets.description: Create a Favorite Snippet with the commonly used fields.

defaultSnippets.label: LiberRPA Favorite Snippet configuration
defaultSnippets.description: Create the complete Favorite Snippet configuration structure.

snippetBody.markdownDescription: Snippet body. Use a string for one line or an array of strings for multiple lines. VS Code Snippet placeholders such as `$1`, `${1:value}`, `${1|one,two|}`, and `$0` are supported.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Insert one or more statements using the current line indentation.
Insert at the current cursor position or replace the current selection.
insertionMode.markdownDescription: Controls how LiberRPA Snippets Tree inserts the Favorite Snippet.

liberrpaImportName.markdownDescription: Name imported from `liberrpa.Modules`. IntelliSense includes the built-in LiberRPA 0.3.0 names; other syntactically valid identifiers remain accepted.

genericImportList.markdownDescription: Original Python names imported from this source. Do not include alias syntax.

imports.markdownDescription: Managed imports required by this Favorite Snippet. Object keys are Python import sources and values are lists of original import names.

favoriteSnippet.markdownDescription: A Favorite Snippet displayed in the `Favorite` Category and available through IntelliSense.

category.markdownDescription: Accepted when copying a Catalog entry, but ignored for Favorite Snippets. Every Favorite is placed in the `Favorite` Category.

label.markdownDescription: Text displayed in LiberRPA Snippets Tree. Defaults to the Favorite title.

prefix.markdownDescription: Text used to find this Favorite through IntelliSense.

description.markdownDescription: Description shown in the Tree and IntelliSense. A fallback description is used when omitted.

defaultSnippets.label: Favorite Snippet
defaultSnippets.description: Define a Favorite Snippet with the commonly used fields.
